== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-r5d4-PC-Errata-2018-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[R5-D4 (Arfive-Defour) (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same game text. This is a full card image again, with the white italic “E” in the black lower border.

The earlier slip and the same area of the new card image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
